testimonials.name: Srinivasan Balasubramanian
testimonials.role: Associate VP, Human Resources, Firstsource Solutions Ltd
paragraphs: My fitness journey with D6 Fitness Studio has been truly transformative. I've gone from 105 kg down to 82 kg, while significantly improving my strength and stability. Beyond the physical changes, it has completely transformed my lifestyle for the better. I am incredibly proud to be a D6 member and highly recommend it to anyone looking to make a positive change!

testimonials.name: Natasha
paragraphs: It’s been about 3 months since I started training at D6 and it’s been one of my most meaningful transformations of my life. I’ve been living with a medical condition and the training has made me stronger both mentally and physically.

One of the highlights has been becoming a runner. I never imagined that I would grow to love running, let alone start participating in marathons and it’s all thanks to Dilip’s motivation where he keeps encouraging us and telling us that we can do it
I’m incredibly happy to be part of this fitness journey and grateful to have a trainer who has helped me build strength, endurance, and confidence along the way.

testimonials.name: Nishalya
paragraphs: I started with doing 9 seconds of dead hang. Now I have progressed to 30+ seconds of dead hang, and I am able to do 12 scapula pull ups. In general, I can see that my strength has only improved after coming to D6. I have to give the credits to Dilip, for his support, training and encouragement in this process.

testimonials.name: Jagannathan.D
paragraphs: D6 Fitness Studio is not just a fitness studio; it is something entirely different from other gyms. I have been to several gyms, but I have never experienced training like the kind offered by Mr. Dilip, the owner and trainer of D6. He shapes and sculpts our bodies with the dedication and precision of a sculptor carefully carving a beautiful statue.
For me, D6 means good health, mental relaxation& two hours of happiness and laughter, enjoying the company of friends just like watching a Sundar C comedy movie!
My day feels complete and enjoyable only after visiting D6. It is a place where I have found wonderful friends, positive energy, and a sense of belonging.
In every sense, D6 is not just a gym; it is one big, happy family.
I warmly invite you to join our D6 family, take care of your physical health, and experience the happiness and positivity that come with being part of this wonderful community.
Come, be a part of D6, stay fit, stay healthy, and stay happy!

testimonials.name: Karthik Rajmohan
testimonials.role: Managing director - Adwants communication Pvt Ltd
paragraphs: It’s been almost a year since I joined D6, and the biggest change for me has been finding the motivation to show up regularly. I was never someone who pushed myself to go to the gym, but Dilip’s encouragement and consistent follow-ups have made a real difference. He’s a wonderful coach who cares about your progress and keeps you going.

D6 is more than a fitness studio—it’s a community. I’ve made some wonderful friends here, and everyone motivates each other. The mix of HIIT, CrossFit and varied workouts keep things fun. And the fun goes beyond the workouts, with outings, shared meals and plenty of laughter. We eat together, then encourage each other to burn those calories too! :P

I’d recommend D6 to anyone looking for a place that makes staying active something to look forward to. Kudos to Dilip for building such a wonderful community where we work out, have fun and grow stronger together.

testimonials.name: Christy Imaya Peter
paragraphs: Walking into D6 was one of the best decisions I made for myself. What started as a weight loss journey 5 months ago has turned into a something much more meaningful – a journey of discovering my own strength and challenging my limits and believing in myself.

Coach Dilip has incredible knowledge, passion and commitment are what truly set this studio apart. He genuinely cares about bringing out the best version of his clients. The energy he brings to the floor, his constant motivation and the standard he sets never allows you to settle for less.
From building strength and endurance, to finding the confidence to take my first 5k run and now chasing the 10K goal, every small milestone & victory is because of D6 & our coach.

And the best part is you never celebrate alone. There’s always a community cheering you on, pushing you forward and genuinely celebrating your progress. There is fun, laughter, positive energy, post work-out breaks, outings which creates an incredible sense of belonging that make you show up every day! And that’s the community Dilip has built!
With D6, it’s just not fitness, it’s my Journey of Believing in Myself!

testimonials.name: Sumita Gupta
testimonials.title: D6 - Where Fitness Meets Joy
paragraphs: I joined D6 on 6th June, and within just a few months, it has become much more than a fitness centre to me, it feels like home.
What sets D6 apart is its impeccable, clean and welcoming environment, but more importantly, its heart, Head Coach Dilip

Dilip is not just the owner; he is a coach who truly embodies what he teaches. His approach is exceptionally thoughtful, cautious and completely injury-free. He takes the time to understand your capacity and never rushes your progress. He builds you up, patiently and progressively.

I still remember, I was someone who couldn't jog even a kilometre. My first ever continuous run happened here, under his guidance. Today, I am comfortably running 10-12 km, and that transformation is entirely credited to his training philosophy.
Beyond the training, D6 has the most balanced and encouraging community. It's not just a gym where people work out in silos; it's a tribe where everyone knows, motivates and uplifts each other.
If you are looking for a place that values your well-being over numbers, D6 is it.
Truly, Fitness with Joy.

testimonials.name: Arjunan
paragraphs: I’ve been working out at this studio gym for the past 7 months and have had a great experience. The gym is always neat, clean, and well-maintained, with a comfortable atmosphere for working out. The coach Dilip is knowledgeable, supportive, and gives personal attention, making it a great place to stay consistent with fitness! He tries to make workouts interesting by incorporating challenges every week and also helps with achieving any personal goals you might have like if it is related to preparing for a marathon or for any hybrid races like Hyrox. Would definitely recommend to folks in and around Neelankarai looking to be consistent with their fitness goals.

testimonials.name: Dr. Harsha
paragraphs: My journey with D6 began three years ago. It's more than a gym, it's a place where friends come together and workouts become fun. Knowing Coach Dilip personally, I can say he has incredible knowledge and passion for fitness. He constantly pushes each one of us beyond our limits. I whole heartedly encourage & recommend everyone to join D6 family and experience the energy on floor, have fun and stay fit.

testimonials.name: Vinoth
paragraphs: Honestly, D6 is not just a gym for me; it’s a fitness community! 💪❤️
From fitness training and HYROX to running with our running coach, we’re constantly learning, improving, and pushing ourselves every day.
And Mr. Dileep is more like a brother to me. I’ve been travelling with him since 2008, and it’s been an amazing journey together.

I always feel that a gym is not just about having the latest machines or equipment. What really matters is how well your trainer understands your body, knows your strengths and limitations, and trains you accordingly with personalised workouts. That’s where D6 really stands out!
I can proudly recommend D6 over any other gym because here, we don’t just work out; we learn, challenge ourselves, have fun, and grow stronger together every single day

testimonials.name: Gopal V.M.K
paragraphs: Joining D6 has been a paradigm shift in how I set and achieve my health goals. Coach Dilip has built an excellent setup with the right tools and a no-nonsense yet never strenuous exercise regime, personalized for each individual.

I turned 50 a couple of years ago and began noticing muscle weakness, so I decided to address it with strength training. I had never set foot in a gym before joining D6 two months ago. Coach Dilip eased me into the routines gradually and made sure I stayed injury-free. Today I feel more energetic, I can perform my routines with confidence, and I've shed a few pounds along the way. I hope to keep this going for many years to come. Thank you, Coach!
D6 is special not only because of the coach but also because of the fellow members, who make it such an enjoyable place to be. It's the reason I look forward to coming to the gym regularly.
